h: Harry Kane names the African artists he listens to around the Ballon d'Or ceremony
p: Newly crowned Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane has reportedly opened up on the African artists he listens to. The comments came around the 2026 awards ceremony in London, where Burna Boy presented an award.
more: Kane won the 2026 Ballon d'Or ahead of Kylian Mbappé.
Nigerian fans have been reacting to his music choices online.
